Stock market news | RBI 25 bps hike base case, SBI warns 50 bps

SBI economists have lowered their expectation for the upcoming RBI policy review to a 0.25 per cent (25 bps) increase, moving away from the previously expected 0.50 per cent (50 bps). This forms the base case for the December meeting. 
The shift reflects worries that a larger hike could threaten financial stability and slow economic growth, affecting borrowers across the economy.
